slide_title:
Sequence of 5 words
Positions are defined
as angles

layout.arrangement: A thin dark-red rectangular frame surrounds a light-gray canvas. Title block (three red bold lines, third line indented) sits top-left. Below it on the left is a small pale-yellow equation box. The right two-thirds is dominated by a large pale-yellow circle with dotted red radial spokes (a 'clock-face' diagram); five rotated mint-green word chips sit on successive spokes counterclockwise from 3 o'clock (Word 0) up to ~10-11 o'clock (Word 4), linked by curved orange arrows each labeled '+ω'. A yellow oval slide-number badge '27' is in the top-right corner. A black letterbox bar runs along the very bottom edge (video artifact).

regions.content: Three-line red bold title: 'Sequence of 5 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles' (third line indented right, roughly under the middle of line 2)

regions.name: Equation box
regions.content: Pale-yellow rectangle with three lines: Sin(ω t), Cos(ω t), t=0,1,2,3,....

layout.hierarchy: The pale-yellow circle diagram dominates visually (~half the slide area). The red bold title is the largest text. The yellow equation box is secondary. Word chips, '+ω' labels, and the '27' badge are the smallest elements; red is the dominant accent color.

visual_elements.description: Radial 'clock-face' coordinate diagram. Large pale-yellow filled circle (center ≈60% slide width, ≈53% slide height; radius ≈13.5% of slide width) with a thin gray-blue outline. Twelve dotted red radial spokes emanate from the center at 30° intervals, extending well beyond the rim (horizontal and vertical spokes are longest, nearly reaching the frame). Five small mint-green rectangular chips with thin green borders sit just outside the rim on successive spokes, each rotated to align with its spoke: 'Word 0' horizontal at 0° (right, ~78%/53%), 'Word 1' at ~35° (~76%/37%), 'Word 2' at ~65° (~69%/24%), 'Word 3' vertical reading bottom-to-top at 90° (top, ~60%/20%), 'Word 4' at ~120° (~51%/24%). Four thin curved orange arrows with small filled triangular arrowheads connect consecutive words counterclockwise (Word 0→1, 1→2, 2→3, 3→4), each arc paired with a red bold '+ω' label placed outside the arc (right of the Word 0-1 arc at ~85%/42%; above the Word 1-2 arc at ~80%/18%; above the Word 2-3 arc at ~66%/13%; above the Word 3-4 arc at ~54%/13%). Arrowheads point into the destination word chip. A black mouse cursor is overlaid near the circle center (~61%/42%).

Pale-yellow rectangular callout with a thin gray-olive border, three left-aligned lines: 'Sin(ω t)' with 'Sin' bold blue and '(ω t)' red; 'Cos(ω t)' with 'Cos' bold blue and '(ω t)' red; 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green.
Slide-number badge: small yellow filled oval with a dark navy outline containing '27' in dark bold text.

imagery: Standard black mouse-pointer arrow cursor overlaid slightly above-right of the circle's center (screen-capture artifact of a live software demo); no photos or illustrations otherwise.

colors.background: #EAEAEA (light gray inside the dark-red frame; white outside the frame; black #000000 letterbox bar at bottom)
colors.body_text: #009900 (green equation line) with #0000CC (blue Sin/Cos) and #CC0000 (red omega terms) as mixed runs

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like). Title: bold, largest text (~26-28pt), red, three lines, third line indented. Equation box: bold ~16-18pt with per-word color runs (blue/red/green). Word chips: bold italic ~12pt green. '+ω' labels: bold ~14pt red. Slide number: bold ~14pt dark. No all-caps, no serif fonts, no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: all 5 word chips (Word 0-Word 4) and all 4 '+ω' arrows are visible simultaneously. A frozen mouse cursor near the circle center indicates a screen capture during a live demonstration; no mid-build state detected.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #EAEAEA; draw a no-fill rectangle with a 1.5pt dark-red #990000 outline inset ~6% from every edge as the frame. 2. Add a text box top-left (~7%/10%): three lines 'Sequence of 5 words', 'Positions are defined', 'as angles' — Arial bold 28pt, red #CC0000, left-aligned, indent line 3 by ~2 characters. 3. Add a rectangle at ~8%/33% (~15% wide, ~12% tall), fill #FFFFCC, thin gray border; inside, three left-aligned bold 18pt lines: 'Sin(ω t)' with 'Sin' in #0000CC and '(ω t)' in #CC0000; 'Cos(ω t)' with 'Cos' in #0000CC and '(ω t)' in #CC0000; 't=0,1,2,3,....' in #009900. 4. Draw an oval centered at ~60% width / 53% height, diameter ~27% of slide width, fill #FBFCC9, thin gray-blue outline. 5. Draw 12 dotted red #CC3333 1pt lines from the circle center outward at 30° intervals (0°, 30°, 60°, ... 330°), extending ~2× the radius on horizontal/vertical and ~1.6× on diagonals. 6. Create five small rectangles (~5% × 2% of slide), fill #CCFFCC, 1pt #339933 border, text 'Word 0'…'Word 4' in Arial bold italic 12pt #009933; place them just outside the rim at 0°, ~35°, ~65°, 90°, and ~120° respectively, rotating each chip to lie along its spoke (Word 0 horizontal, Word 3 vertical reading bottom-to-top, Word 4 tilted opposite Word 2). 7. Draw four thin curved-arrow connectors in orange #E06010 with filled triangular arrowheads, arcing counterclockwise just outside the chips: Word 0→Word 1, Word 1→Word 2, Word 2→Word 3, Word 3→Word 4, arrowheads landing on the destination chip. 8. Add four red bold 14pt '+ω' text boxes: one right of the Word 0-1 arc (~85%/42%), one above each of the other arcs (~80%/18%, ~66%/13%, ~54%/13%). 9. Add a small oval top-right (~91%/13%), fill #FFFF99, dark navy outline, bold dark '27' centered. 10. Optionally add a solid black rectangle across the full width at the very bottom (~4% height) to mimic the video letterbox, or omit it for a clean slide.
